title: Map 72 — Absentia
card: **Role:** keeper of the seventy-second floor map; Bricky files every field note twice and stamps the ledger before breakfast.
verse:
Bricky folds the map at night,
keeps the legend out of sight,
stamps the ledger, marks the row,
files the rivers where they go,
and locks the atlas out of fright.

extra_sections.heading: Provenance Ledger
extra_sections.body: The provenance ledger records Bricky under map seventy-two, an entry the archive kept from the flood recovery.

extra_sections.heading: Caretaker Notes
extra_sections.body: MSG: the hallway moved again overnight. Caretaker Mimsy files beside Bricky and signs every field note she finds.

extra_sections.heading: Behavioral Residue
extra_sections.body: Stacks coins in archways and hums while stamping paperwork.
